### Show HN: Overdesigned Simple Solitaire 👤 fsloth
> I got irritated by the maximalism and lack of aesthetics present in modern software when trying to find a nice solitaire. A solitaire does not need a score, levels - and most of all it does not need to download anything, have user log in or do anything else except maintain game state. So since software comes automatically nowadays, I decided as a weekend project to create the last solitaire I&#x27;ll ever need. The application is built on Rust so I can compile it to native. But it runs just as well as web app! I geeked out completely on design (it may look like "default" but that&#x27;s the point) to create as non-intruding yet aesthetically pleasing experience as I could. I might have accidentally put in a complete card design system with a content pipeline (maybe I&#x27;ll do default blackjack next) - but as a player you only see the one pack of cards. Anyway, hope someone here appreciates the minimalistic aesthetics. The game state is saved in the url so if you want to save a nice game you can do it by copypasting the link. The game engine is versioned so if I ever change the engine or state schema there will be support for the current version as well. There _is_ a novelty. If you click the "teach" button it shows all the available free moves as arrows. Hope this is fun for someone!

🔗 [官网](https://defaultsolitaire.app/)

### 做了个免费工具：写 Markdown，一键排好 X（Twitter）长文，代码、表格、Mermaid 图自动转图片 👤 echoVic
> 在 X 上发技术长文（ Articles ）时一直有个痛点：X 的编辑器不认 Markdown 。 我平时用 Markdown 写稿，每次往 X 上发都要： - 手动重新设置标题、加粗、链接 - 一段段截图代码块 - 表格截图 - Mermaid 流程图先去 mermaid.live 导出，再一张张传上去 一篇稍长的技术文，光排版就要半小时。所以做了这个： **MD2X** → https://markdown2x.com/zh **能做什么** - 左边写 Markdown ，右边实时预览 X 长文的效果 - 「复制标题」「复制正文」，粘到 X 里标题、加粗、链接、列表都保留 - 代码块 → 带语法高亮的 PNG （ 9 种主题：GitHub 、Dracula 、Nord 、One Dark Pro 、Tokyo Night……） - Markdown 表格 → 干净的表格图片 - Mermaid → PNG ，配色跟着亮色/暗色主题走 - 所有图片可以逐张复制，也可以一键打包 ZIP 下载 - 还能把一篇 Markdown 拆成带编号的推文串（ Thread ） **单项小工具**（不用打开编辑器） - Mermaid 转 PNG： https://markdown2x.com/zh/mermaid-to-png - 代码转图片： https://markdown2x.com/zh/code-to-image - Markdown 表格转图片： https://markdown2x.com/zh/markdown-table-to-image **其他** - 免费，不用注册 - 纯浏览器运行，草稿存在 localStorage ，不上传 - 支持 PWA 离线使用、暗色模式、中英文界面 - 开源： https://github.com/echoVic/x-article-md - 技术栈：Next.js 16 + TypeScript + Tailwind ，Mermaid 和代码都在浏览器里用 Canvas 渲染成图片 **想听听大家的意见** 1. 你往 X / 公众号贴技术内容时，还有哪些格式会乱？ 2. 如果做成 Chrome 插件，直接写进 X 的编辑器，省掉复制粘贴这一步，你会用吗？ 有 bug 或建议直接回复，我都会看。
